notes.note: CP00's program COPAUA0C starts with EXEC CICS RETRIEVE INTO(MQTM) and takes the request queue name from MQTM-QNAME, i.e. it is written to be started with an MQ trigger message rather than from a screen; it sends no map. The process or queue definition that starts CP00 is not a scanned input, so the entry-point ask stays open.

Per request message: schedule the PSB, read the card cross-reference, account, customer and pending-authorization summary, decide, MQPUT1 the reply to the request's reply-to queue, then write the authorization to IMS when the card was found. It declines when the amount exceeds credit limit minus balance (from the IMS summary when one exists, else the account record) or when no account is found.

asks.message: nothing in the scanned estate transfers to TRANID CP00, so it is taken to be entered from outside it (typed at a terminal, started by an unscanned program or region)
asks.request: Confirm how CP00 is started (a terminal user, another region, an operator or automation product), or provide the caller that transfers to it

notes.note: Screen flow: COPAUS1C sends map COPAU1A (mapset COPAU01) - one authorization in detail. Entered with no COMMAREA it XCTLs straight to COPAUS0C; otherwise ENTER redisplays, PF8 shows the next authorization, PF5 toggles the fraud flag (LINK to COPAUS2C, then IMS REPL or rollback), PF3 XCTLs back to COPAUS0C.

The detail program is reached from the summary screen: COPAUS0C moves WS-PGM-AUTH-DTL ('COPAUS1C') to CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM and XCTLs with CARDDEMO-COMMAREA. COPAUS1C extends COCOM01Y with CDEMO-CPVD-INFO, which adds CDEMO-CPVD-FRAUD-DATA PIC X(100) after the fields COPAUS0C declares.

Fraud marking writes two stores in one unit of work: COPAUS2C inserts into (or, on SQLCODE -803, updates) Db2 table CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS, and COPAUS1C then replaces the IMS detail segment and takes a syncpoint, or issues SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK when the Db2 step failed.

notes.note: Screen flow: COPAUS0C sends map COPAU0A (mapset COPAU00) - the pending-authorization list for an account. ENTER with 'S' against a row XCTLs to COPAUS1C (detail); PF7/PF8 page; PF3 XCTLs to WS-PGM-MENU ('COMEN01C', outside the AUTH scan); any other key redisplays with an invalid-key message. Which branch runs depends on the AID key and the selection field - unknown at analysis time.

The XCTL at COPAUS0C.cbl:322 is resolved to COPAUS1C and the one at :674 is narrowed to COMEN01C (derived, annotations.json); COMEN01C belongs to module CARDDEMO per the estate catalog and is not followed here, so the online-transid-variable ask for CPVS stays open.

State between screens is CARDDEMO-COMMAREA: copybook COCOM01Y extended in the program by CDEMO-CPVS-INFO (selection flag and key, 20 previous-page keys, last key, page number, next-page flag, 5 row keys). RETURN TRANSID(WS-CICS-TRANID) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) carries no LENGTH option, so the size the scan could not read is the length of that 01 level.
